name: BG-02-01 政务网页 HTML 格式规范性检测

include_roles.description: Only scan matching HTML ContentItem roles.

include_content_ids.description: Only scan matching content IDs; omitted means all IDs.

enabled_checks.description: Enabled detection check keys; omitted means all six.

compliance_basis.description: Which violations enter compliant_record_ratio; heuristic suspects are counted separately by default.

font_size_min_px.description: Absolute minimum body font size in px.

font_size_max_px.description: Absolute maximum body font size in px.

font_size_outlier_scale.description: Relative deviation from the document body baseline treated as an outlier.

font_size_baseline_dominance.description: Character-volume share required to treat a declared size/family as the document baseline.

font_family_minority_ratio.description: Minimum character share for inconsistent families to be reported as mixing.

line_height_min_px.description: Extreme lower bound for line-height in px after unit conversion.

line_height_max_px.description: Extreme upper bound for line-height in px after unit conversion.

text_indent_max_em.description: Maximum text-indent in em relative to the element font size.

text_indent_max_px.description: Maximum text-indent in px when the element font size is unknown.

negative_margin_tolerance_px.description: Negative margin/text-indent magnitude tolerated before reporting.

paragraph_margin_max_px.description: Maximum vertical paragraph margin in px.

consecutive_empty_block_threshold.description: Consecutive blank p/div blocks reported as excessive.

consecutive_br_threshold.description: Consecutive br elements reported as excessive.

layout_residue_patterns.description: Regex patterns over the tag#id.class signature for DOM layout residue.

max_html_length_chars.description: Per-content HTML length guard; longer payloads are skipped and counted as HTML_TOO_LARGE.

max_evidence_per_record.description: Maximum evidence rows emitted per SampleRecord; aggregate counts remain uncapped.

covered: inline-style font-size outliers and font-family mixing with basic CSS inheritance
extreme line-height, text-indent, negative margins and paragraph spacing
consecutive blank blocks and br runs
table hierarchy, span validity and row-span conflicts
DOM-level page-furniture residue (nav, breadcrumb, footer, print toolbar)
excluded: PDF/DOCX/OFD physical layout and cross-page table breaks
browser computed styles and external CSS cascade
Unicode validity and mojibake (covered by sample_text_encoding_compliance)
text-noise and advertising markers (covered by text_purity)
limitations: heuristics use generic web-page thresholds, not a formal government typography standard
SUSPECTED findings are excluded from the default compliance ratio
